# Exercises 2


## Introduction
This is an example of an R Markdown document in VSCode

Probability

```{r}
sample <- c("W", "L", "W", "W", "W", "L", "W", "L", "W")
W <- sum(sample=="W") # number of W observed
L <- sum(sample=="L") # number of L observed
p <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1) # proportions W
ways <- sapply(p, function(q) (q*4)^W * ((1-q)*4)^L)
prob <- ways/sum(ways)
cbind(p, ways, prob)
```

# function to toss a globe covered p by water N times
```{r}
sim_globe <- function(p=0.7, N=9) {
    sample(c("W","L"), size=N, replace=TRUE, prob=c(p,1-p))
}
```

```{r}
sim_globe()
replicate(sim_globe(p=0.5, N=9), n=10)
```

# Test the simulation on extreme settings
```{r}
sim_globe(p=1, N=11)
sum(sim_globe(p=0.5, N=le4) == "W") / le4
```
